* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CJ.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Home Coming|Home Coming]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Sweet.png]]Momma's House, Los Santos
|}

For this, go with Sweet to B-Dup's apartment, and then to Glen Park. Provoke a gang war, win, and kill the Ballas around B-Dup's house. Watch the cut-scene, and Mission Complete.
{{-}}
== Tips ==
Start the gang war from the tunnel walkway in the northern middle of the park where the police badge is.  By using the sniper rifle, you can kill the gang when they are far away, and the police won't notice you and cause trouble.

Make sure your body armour is full when you start walking towards the house, as the Ballas outside have AK-47s.

== Rewards ==
Respect +
